description: This Java class 'IncomingDataBuffer' implements a thread-safe byte queue with blocking read capabilities, used for buffering incoming data from a controller in a software project. It manages a circular byte buffer and provides methods to add data, wait for specific byte counts, drop pending data, and retrieve bytes or primitive data types, all with synchronized access for thread safety.

classes.name: IncomingDataBuffer
classes.description: A thread-safe buffer class for managing incoming binary data streams from hardware controllers, supporting blocking reads and overflow handling.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Adds an array of bytes to the buffer, logging the event and clearing the buffer if overflow is detected.

methods.name: waitForBytes
methods.description: Blocks execution until the specified number of bytes are available or the timeout occurs, returning true on timeout.

methods.name: dropPending
methods.description: Clears any pending data in the buffer and logs the discarded data.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Retrieves a 2-byte short value from the buffer, throws EOFException if not enough data.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves a 4-byte integer value from the buffer, throws EOFException if not enough data.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Copies available data into the provided byte array.
